controls.title: A unique battery identifier and a data carrier (QR code) are on the battery and link to the passport
controls.evidenceExpectation: Photo or drawing of the marked identifier and QR code, plus the resolvable passport URL for one production sample.

controls.title: Manufacturer, battery category, weight, capacity and chemistry are disclosed in the passport
controls.evidenceExpectation: Export of the passport record showing each declared field with its source system and last-updated date.

controls.title: A carbon footprint declaration per functional unit is available
controls.evidenceExpectation: The signed carbon-footprint declaration (kg CO2e per kWh over the service life) with the calculation method and dataset references.

controls.title: The carbon footprint performance class label is applied
controls.evidenceExpectation: The label artwork with the assigned class and the delegated-act threshold table used to assign it.

controls.title: Recycled cobalt, nickel, lithium and lead content is disclosed
controls.evidenceExpectation: The recycled-content declaration per metal with the third-party verification statement.

controls.title: State-of-health and expected lifetime data are available in the passport
controls.evidenceExpectation: A sample passport export showing the SoH parameters and the update mechanism (BMS field, API, or manual).

controls.title: A supply-chain due-diligence policy is published and a report is available
controls.evidenceExpectation: The published due-diligence policy and the most recent third-party-verified due-diligence report.

controls.title: Separate-collection marking and end-of-life information are provided
controls.evidenceExpectation: The crossed-out wheeled-bin marking, the substance symbols where required, and the take-back information given to end users.
